evidence.note: Replaces the cosine learning-rate schedule with a constant learning rate followed by a cooldown, so that scaling-law experiments can reuse a single training run across many training durations.
evidence.title: Scaling Laws and Compute-Optimal Training Beyond Fixed Training Durations

evidence.note: Reports 11 tasks, found via the Inverse Scaling Prize contest, on which language model accuracy declines as model parameter count and training compute increase, and analyzes why.
evidence.title: Inverse Scaling: When Bigger Isn't Better
